data.name: Green Carbon Solutions
data.description: Green Carbon Solutions is an Indiantown, Florida climate-tech company founded by Martin Ellis that pyrolyzes eucalyptus wood into biochar, activated carbon, bio-oil, and bio-energy. The plant was relocated from Poland and retrofitted with a 110-foot retort; primary target markets are high-purity silicon/semiconductor, metallurgical industry (via a Polchar licensing deal), water purification, and soil amendment, with carbon sequestration as one of several product lines.
